State the services supplied in one paragraph. Reference the
agreement or purchase order.

# Items

List the items in a table with description, quantity, rate, and
amount columns.

# Payment

State the total, the currency, and the due date. Name the payment
method and bank details.

# Notes

Add any notes the client needs. State the late payment terms if
they apply.
